style: Detailed realistic dark-fantasy creature illustration. Fine pen and ink linework with cross-hatching defines the form and shadow; grounded believable anatomy with real weight, weathered skin, dirt, moss and old scars; small deep-set eyes; genuinely frightening and menacing, never cute, no exaggerated cartoon proportions, no gore. Over the ink, a restrained hand-painted color wash in muted earth browns, moss greens, bone and misty blue-grey, under soft natural daylight: only a slight touch, about one part in ten, of the gentle warmth of classic hand-drawn animation film art in the color and light, never in the creature's design. Full body, single creature, facing left, three-quarter view, thin drifting mist and a soft shadow at its feet, plain pale off-white background, square image, no text, no border, no signature, no saturated or neon colors
